refreshPolicy.note: GitHub Pages serves static JSON. The page checks for newer JSON regularly; GitHub Actions refreshes the source files on schedule.

comparison.interpretation: positive improvement means the model beats the market baseline

shadowCandidateRobustness.policy: Retrospective candidate search may nominate a frozen candidate, but guarded activation also requires an untouched prospective confirmation bound to the same candidate and committed candidate inventory.

modelSignal.policy: Model and historical-signal candidates remain shadow until they are non-worse than the same-temperature market calibration, every promotion-evidence decision clock verifies, and the current evaluation artifact is the hash-matched Champion in a valid model-learning registry.

comparison.interpretation: positive improvement means the model beats the market baseline

productionValidation.policy: Only immutable v2 candidates with exact canonical input/output/policy replay enter promotion validation; v1 remains audit-only and a probability/odds proxy cannot promote the production policy.

continuity.policy: After the first eligible boundary, every evaluation block is contiguous; missing candidate coverage blocks promotion instead of skipping a window.

walkForwardValidation.policy: Each fold selects a frozen model-signal candidate only from unique outcomes observed before that fold, then scores every untouched contiguous chronological block against the canonical same-match devigged market. Candidate coverage gaps and conflicting duplicate rows fail closed.

promotionGate.policy: Model strategy stays shadow until it has clean pre-match inputs, a hash-valid promotion manifest backed by complete decision-clock records, a versioned walk-forward protocol, stable out-of-sample gains, exact production-policy replay, and a matching promoted Champion in the validated model-learning registry.

HHAD_COMPANION.interpretation: candidate-ready permits manual evaluation only; onlineEffect remains shadow

riskGuard.policy: Online strategy may tighten recommendation gates from audited backtests while risk is watch or degraded, but loosening is blocked until the model risk tier is stable.

activation.note: Strategy is shadow-only until the promotion manifest, decision clocks, and model-learning Champion authority all verify.

historicalTraining.cutoffPolicy: aggregate seeds include results through sample.lastMatchDate; incremental Elo replays only matches whose kickoffTime is later than that event cutoff
